own_solution.law: Snell's law gives theta_r = asin(sin(40 degrees)/1.8). Specular reflection at the straight sides preserves axial speed, so t = nL/(c cos(theta_r)). With c = 3.0e8 m/s, the base transit time is 12.847078 ns. An inline extension q replaces L by L+q.
assumptions: The glass is nondispersive, giving pulse speed c/n.
Side reflections are specular and totally internal as stated.
The inline extension continues the optical path through the same glass.
An extension used for an earlier run only is absent from the current run.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T97AD and TACC7 omit the number and unit retained by the other extension sentences, departing from the review instructions' general numerical-matching requirement, although the authors explicitly identify them as numeral-free controls.
